title: Graceful entitlement transfer for merged organizations
creator: Aisha Raman
description: When two customer organizations are merged (customer-initiated or admin-initiated), their reserved capacity, monthly/daily quotas, and burst seats need to be transferred without double-counting, loss of entitlement, or incorrect mid-window resets. Current behavior causes transient double-billing or missing credits during the migration window for a subset of cross-region merges and timezone boundary cases. This ticket designs and implements a reliable entitlement transfer protocol: an ephemeral overlay ledger and hold period that lets us move quota units between orgs deterministically while preserving per-tenant meter continuity and billing correctness.
acceptance_criteria: Entitlement transfer path preserves total committed reserved units across merge event with no double-counted tokens in production canary runs
Merged org shows correct remaining quota in Console and API within 60 seconds of finalization for 99% of test cases
Audit trail produced for every transfer with before/after ledger snapshots available in billing logs and Console UI
No regression in latency for quota checks under normal traffic (<5% p95 increase)
Automated integration test matrix covers same-region, cross-region, and timezone-boundary merges, including month boundary and DST cases
tasks: Spike: simulate org-merge scenarios and enumerate failure modes (double-count, lost credits, mid-window resets)
Design: entitlement overlay ledger schema and transfer finite-state-machine (hold->apply->confirm->release)
Implement: transfer coordinator service with idempotent operations and compensating actions
Integrate: hook coordinator into quota service and reserved-pool allocator with feature flag gating
Telemetry: add transfer_start/transfer_applied/transfer_reconciled events and expose dashboard
Tests: unit tests, property tests for idempotency, and staged integration tests in staging cluster
Canary rollout: 5% orgs for 48h, monitor anomalies, then 25% then 100%
Docs: update Console FAQ and internal runbook with manual rollback steps and billing team contact
